```{r load-db1b, include=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(here)
library(fs)
library(gt)

dir_create("outputs/figs")
dir_create("outputs/tabs")

source(here("R", "01_ingest.R"))
source(here("R", "02_prepare.R"))

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())

# Lecture de la table de données des marchés DB1B
dbExecute(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW mkt AS
     SELECT *
     FROM read_parquet('%s', hive_partitioning = true)",
    here("data/interim/MARKET/DB1B/**/*.parquet")
  )
)

mkt <- tbl(con, "mkt")

# Création du vecteur nommé des différentes tables de référence
lookups <- load_lookups(
  here("data/external/refs/") |> dir_ls(glob = "*ref_*.csv")
)
```

```{r weighted-functions}
# Déclaration des fonctions de calcul des statistiques pondérées
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

weighted_quantile <- function(x, w, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w) & w > 0

  x <- x[keep]
  w <- w[keep]

  ord <- order(x)
  x <- x[ord]
  w <- w[ord]

  cw <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)

  sapply(
    probs,
    \(p) x[which(cw >= p)[1]]
  )
}

weighted_stats <- function(x, w) {
  q <- weighted_quantile(x, w)

  tibble(
    Minimum = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = q[1],
    Médiane = q[2],
    Moyenne = weighted.mean(x, w, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = q[3],
    Maximum = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

# Caractéristiques générales de la table de données DB1B

```{r compute-general-characteristics}
# Calcul des caractéristiques générales du jeu de données
general_stats <- mkt |>
  summarise(
    first_period = min(Year * 4 + Quarter, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_period = max(Year * 4 + Quarter, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows = n(),
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  collect()

origins <- mkt |>
  select(OriginCityMarketID) |>
  distinct() |>
  summarise(origins = n()) |>
  collect() |>
  pull(origins)

destinations <- mkt |>
  select(DestCityMarketID) |>
  distinct() |>
  summarise(destinations = n()) |>
  collect() |>
  pull(destinations)

markets <- mkt |>
  select(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID) |>
  filter(OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID) |>
  distinct() |>
  summarise(markets = n()) |>
  collect() |>
  pull(markets)

carriers <- mkt |>
  select(TkCarrier) |>
  distinct() |>
  summarise(carriers = n()) |>
  collect() |>
  pull(carriers)

period_label <- function(x) {
  year <- (x - 1) %/% 4
  quarter <- (x - 1) %% 4 + 1

  paste0(year, " T", quarter)
}
```

```{r render-general-characteristics, echo=FALSE}
table_general <- tibble(
  Caractéristique = c(
    "Première période",
    "Dernière période",
    "Nombre de lignes",
    "Nombre de passagers",
    "Nombre d'origines",
    "Nombre de destinations",
    "Nombre de marchés OD",
    "Nombre de transporteurs"
  ),
  Valeur = c(
    period_label(general_stats$first_period),
    period_label(general_stats$last_period),
    comma(general_stats$rows),
    comma(general_stats$passengers),
    comma(origins),
    comma(destinations),
    comma(markets),
    comma(carriers)
  )
)

table_general_gt <- table_general |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    Caractéristique = "Caractéristique",
    Valeur = "Valeur"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Caractéristique) |>
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = Valeur) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table_body.hlines.color = "transparent",
    stub.border.color = "transparent"
  )

table_general_gt |> gtsave("tab_eda-general.html", path = "outputs/tabs/")

table_general_gt
```

```{r compute-annual-markets}
# Calcul du nombre de marchés origine-destination par année
annual_markets <- mkt |>
  select(
    Year,
    OriginCityMarketID,
    DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(OriginCityMarketID),
    !is.na(DestCityMarketID),
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  summarise(
    markets = n(),
    .by = Year
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(Year)
```

```{r compute-annual-characteristics}
# Calcul du nombre de passagers par année
annual_passengers <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

# Calcul du prix moyen du billet par année
# Calcul du prix moyen pondéré du billet par année
annual_fare <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    fare = sum(MktFare * Passengers, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(Passengers, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

# Regroupement du nombre de passagers et du prix moyen du billet par année
annual_stats <- annual_passengers |> left_join(annual_fare, by = "Year")
```

# Caractéristiques du prix et du yield

```{r compute-fare-yield-characteristics}
# Calcul des statistiques pondérées du prix du billet et du yield
fare_dist <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    Passengers > 0
  ) |>
  group_by(MktFare) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

# Calcul de la distribution pondérée du yield
yield_dist <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(MktMilesFlown),
    MktMilesFlown > 0,
    !is.na(Passengers),
    Passengers > 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    yield = MktFare / MktMilesFlown
  ) |>
  group_by(yield) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()
```

```{r render-fare-yield-characteristics, echo=FALSE}
# Regroupement des statistiques pondérées du prix du billet et du yield
table_fare_yield <- bind_rows(
  weighted_stats(fare_dist$MktFare, fare_dist$passengers) |>
    mutate(Variable = "Prix du billet"),
  weighted_stats(yield_dist$yield, yield_dist$passengers) |>
    mutate(Variable = "Yield")
) |>
  select(Variable, everything())

table_fare_yield_gt <- table_fare_yield |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Minimum, Q1, Médiane, Moyenne, Q3, Maximum),
    decimals = 2,
    sep_mark = ","
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Variable) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(Minimum, Q1, Médiane, Moyenne, Q3, Maximum)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table_body.hlines.color = "transparent",
    stub.border.color = "transparent"
  )

table_fare_yield_gt |> gtsave("tab_eda-fare-yield.html", path = "outputs/tabs/")

table_fare_yield_gt
```

```{r compute-quarter-characteristics}
# Calcul des statistiques descriptives selon le trimestre
quarter_passengers <- mkt |>
  group_by(Quarter) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

# Calcul du prix moyen pondéré selon le trimestre
quarter_fare <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers)
  ) |>
  group_by(Quarter) |>
  summarise(
    fare = sum(MktFare * Passengers, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(Passengers, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

# Calcul du yield moyen pondéré selon le trimestre
quarter_yield <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(MktMilesFlown),
    MktMilesFlown > 0,
    !is.na(Passengers)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    yield = MktFare / MktMilesFlown
  ) |>
  group_by(Quarter) |>
  summarise(
    yield = sum(yield * Passengers, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(Passengers, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

# Calcul de la distribution pondérée du prix du billet selon le trimestre
quarter_fare_dist <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    Passengers > 0
  ) |>
  group_by(Quarter, MktFare) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

# Calcul du prix médian pondéré selon le trimestre
quarter_median <- quarter_fare_dist |>
  group_by(Quarter) |>
  summarise(
    fare_median = weighted_quantile(MktFare, passengers, probs = 0.5),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r compute-fare-boxplot}
# Déclaration de la fonction de calcul des statistiques d'une boîte à moustaches
weighted_box <- function(x, w) {
  q <- weighted_quantile(x, w, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))

  iqr <- q[3] - q[1]

  lower_limit <- q[1] - 1.5 * iqr
  upper_limit <- q[3] + 1.5 * iqr

  tibble(
    ymin = min(x[x >= lower_limit], na.rm = TRUE),
    lower = q[1],
    middle = q[2],
    upper = q[3],
    ymax = max(x[x <= upper_limit], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# Calcul des statistiques pondérées du prix du billet selon le trimestre
quarter_fare_dist <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  group_by(Quarter, MktFare) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

fare_box <- quarter_fare_dist |>
  group_by(Quarter) |>
  group_modify(\(data, key) {
    weighted_box(data$MktFare, data$passengers)
  }) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r compute-fare-distributions}
# Échantillonnage du logarithme du prix du billet
set.seed(42)

fare_sample <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT LN(MktFare) AS log_MktFare
  FROM mkt
  WHERE MktFare > 0
    AND BulkFare = 0
  USING SAMPLE 10000 ROWS
  "
)

# Agrégation du nombre de passagers selon le logarithme du prix du billet
fare_hist <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT
    FLOOR(LN(MktFare) / 0.15) * 0.15 AS log_MktFare,
    SUM(Passengers * 10) AS passengers
  FROM mkt
  WHERE MktFare > 0
    AND BulkFare = 0
    AND Passengers IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY 1
  "
)
```

```{r render-fare-distributions, echo=FALSE}
# Trace le diagramme quantile-quantile du logarithme du prix du billet
ggplot(fare_sample, aes(sample = log_MktFare)) +
  stat_qq(alpha = 0.1) +
  stat_qq_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Quantile théorique",
    y = "Quantile observé"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("outputs/figs/fig_eda-fare-qq.pdf", width = 4, height = 5)

# Trace la distribution du logarithme du prix du billet
ggplot(fare_hist, aes(x = log_MktFare, y = passengers)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey50", width = 0.15) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6)) +
  labs(
    x = "Log(Prix du billet) (en dollars américains)",
    y = "Nombre de passagers (en millions)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("outputs/figs/fig_eda-fare-hist.pdf", width = 4, height = 5)
```

```{r compute-distance-coupon-characteristics}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Calcul des distributions pondérées de la distance et du nombre de coupons
distance_dist <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktDistance),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID,
    # AirportGroup %in% valid_airports
  ) |>
  group_by(MktDistance) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

# Calcul de la distribution pondérée du nombre de coupons
coupon_dist <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktCoupons),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID,
    # AirportGroup %in% valid_airports
  ) |>
  group_by(MktCoupons) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()
```

```{r render-distance-coupon-characteristics, echo=FALSE}
# Regroupement des statistiques pondérées de la distance et du nombre de coupons
table_distance_coupon <- bind_rows(
  weighted_stats(distance_dist$MktDistance, distance_dist$passengers) |>
    mutate(Variable = "Distance parcourue"),
  weighted_stats(coupon_dist$MktCoupons, coupon_dist$passengers) |>
    mutate(Variable = "Nombre de coupons")
) |>
  select(Variable, everything())

table_distance_coupon_gt <- table_distance_coupon |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Minimum, Q1, Médiane, Moyenne, Q3, Maximum),
    decimals = 2,
    sep_mark = ","
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Variable) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(Minimum, Q1, Médiane, Moyenne, Q3, Maximum)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table_body.hlines.color = "transparent",
    stub.border.color = "transparent"
  )

table_distance_coupon_gt |>
  gtsave("tab_eda-distance-coupon.html", path = "outputs/tabs/")

table_distance_coupon_gt
```

# Répartition du nombre de coupons

```{r compute-coupon-distribution}
# Calcul de la répartition du nombre de passagers selon le nombre de coupons
table_coupons <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktCoupons),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    coupons = case_when(
      MktCoupons == 1 ~ "1",
      MktCoupons == 2 ~ "2",
      MktCoupons == 3 ~ "3",
      MktCoupons >= 4 ~ "4 ou plus"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(coupons) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(
      Passengers * 10,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    share = passengers / sum(passengers),
    coupons = factor(
      coupons,
      levels = c(
        "1",
        "2",
        "3",
        "4 ou plus"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(coupons)
```

```{r render-coupon-distribution, echo=FALSE}
table_coupons_gt <- table_coupons |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    coupons = "Nombre de coupons",
    passengers = "Passagers",
    share = "Part"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = passengers, decimals = 0, sep_mark = ",") |>
  fmt_percent(columns = share, decimals = 1) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = coupons) |>
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = c(passengers, share)) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table_body.hlines.color = "transparent",
    stub.border.color = "transparent"
  )

table_coupons_gt |> gtsave("tab_eda-coupons.html", path = "outputs/tabs/")

table_coupons_gt
```

# Principaux marchés origine-destination

```{r compute-top-markets}
# Calcul du nombre total de passagers
total_passengers <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  pull(passengers)

# Sélection des dix principaux marchés origine-destination
top_markets <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  group_by(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(passengers)) |>
  head(10) |>
  recode_cols(
    c("OriginCityMarketID", "DestCityMarketID"),
    list(lookups$city_market_id, lookups$city_market_id)
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(desc(passengers)) |>
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    share = passengers / total_passengers
  ) |>
  select(
    rank,
    OriginCityMarketID,
    DestCityMarketID,
    passengers,
    share
  )
```

```{r render-top-markets, echo=FALSE}
top_markets_gt <- top_markets |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    rank = "Rang",
    OriginCityMarketID = "Origine",
    DestCityMarketID = "Destination",
    passengers = "Passagers",
    share = "Part"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = passengers, decimals = 0, sep_mark = ",") |>
  fmt_percent(columns = share, decimals = 2) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(OriginCityMarketID, DestCityMarketID)
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = rank) |>
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = c(passengers, share)) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table_body.hlines.color = "transparent",
    stub.border.color = "transparent"
  )

top_markets_gt |> gtsave("tab_eda-top-markets.html", path = "outputs/tabs/")
```

```{r compute-top-carriers}
# Sélection des huit principaux transporteurs selon le nombre de passagers
top_carriers <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  group_by(TkCarrier) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  recode_col("TkCarrier", lookups$carriers) |>
  arrange(desc(passengers)) |>
  head(8) |>
  collect()

total_passengers <- mkt |>
  filter(
    !is.na(MktFare),
    !is.na(Passengers),
    MktFare > 0,
    Passengers > 0,
    BulkFare == 0,
    OriginCityMarketID != DestCityMarketID
  ) |>
  summarise(
    passengers = sum(Passengers * 10, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  pull(passengers)

# Regroupement des autres transporteurs dans une même catégorie
carrier_share <- bind_rows(
  top_carriers,
  tibble(
    TkCarrier = "Autres",
    passengers = total_passengers - sum(top_carriers$passengers)
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    share = passengers / total_passengers,
    TkCarrier = factor(
      TkCarrier,
      levels = rev(c(top_carriers$TkCarrier, "Autres"))
    )
  )
```

```{r render-top-carriers, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(carrier_share, aes(x = TkCarrier, y = share)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "grey50") +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)), hjust = -0.1) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Part des passagers (en pourcentage)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("outputs/figs/fig_eda-od.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)
```
